verdict.rationale: Rive documents open-source official runtimes (SDKs) for web, mobile, game engines, and other platforms, with a public GitHub repo (rive-runtime) implementing the loading/rendering API, plus explicit guidance on caching and using the same exported .riv file across supported runtimes. This directly satisfies 'build against official SDKs' for developers, including AI-native workflows via RML/MCP integration for programmatic file creation. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of SDK quality/completeness across all listed platforms and more granular per-language SDK documentation (e.g., npm/Swift/Kotlin package specifics).
